MacauDraw.title: MacauDraw
MacauDraw.description: Historical Toto Macau draw entry used for probability predictions.

id.description: Unique identifier of the draw (typically incremental string).

date.description: Date of the draw in YYYY-MM-DD format.

digits.description: Array of 4 individual digits: [As, Kop, Kepala, Ekor].

isFromOcr.description: Indicates if the draw result was imported from an uploaded image via OCR.

draws/{drawId}.description: Persistent collection containing all recorded historical Toto Macau drawings.
